name: Gokujou Chikan Densha ~ Kairaku Zecchou Rush Hour
original_name: 極嬢痴漢電車～快楽絶頂ラッシュアワー
source:
Tadashi is a high school teacher living a stressful life at school. "Ok, I'll leave my stress behind doing "this"...." It's train molestation in a crowded train. This is his way of relaxing and he has never got arrested. He suddenly comes up with an idea. "Right. I can make them my sex slaves like this...." He finally decides to take revenge.... "It's you who are at fault. I'll get even with you now...."

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090106044150/http://www.erogeshop.com/product_info.php/cPath/146_45/products_id/1010850]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
正是一名高中老师，在学校生活压力很大。“好吧，我会把压力抛在脑后，做‘这个’……”这是在拥挤的火车上进行的火车骚扰。这是他放松的方式，他从未被捕。他突然想到一个主意。“好吧，我可以让他们就这样成为我的性奴隶……”他终于决定报仇……“错的是你，我现在就跟你报仇……”
